cohort: 227 pregnant women (121 housewives and 106 employed women) attending health centers in Zahedan city, Iran in 2014, with no chronic diseases, singleton pregnancy, gravida 1-3, and no addiction
finding: Lifting heavy objects during pregnancy was associated with increased complications such as reduced amniotic fluid, placental abruption, and low birth weight, and was more frequent among housewives.
mod_finding: Employed mothers had a higher frequency of cesarean deliveries compared to housewives.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was found to be associated with lifting heavy objects
